name: glab
description: GitLab CLI (glab) workflow automation for working with GitLab repositories, merge requests, issues, CI/CD pipelines, and APIs. Use when interacting with GitLab via the glab CLI, when given a GitLab URL (such as merge requests or issues), or when asked to view, diff, checkout, review, create, update, approve, label, or comment on merge requests (MRs); view, search, create, close, or update issues, work items, or epics; inspect pipeline status, stream or view CI logs and traces (glab ci trace), or retry jobs; call the GitLab REST or GraphQL API through glab api; or configure glab auth. Read before any glab write operation, because several field flags fail silently - they exit 0 while posting the wrong content. Triggers: glab, glab CLI, GitLab CLI, GitLab URL, merge request, MR diff, view MR, review MR, issue view, CI trace, pipeline status, job logs, glab api.
